newsitem.title: DENMARK: Uncertainty about Danish shares after Tele Danmark.
newsitem.headline: Uncertainty about Danish shares after Tele Danmark.

text.p: Danish share prices slipped in early trade on Monday, hit by a statement from Tele Danmark about expected major annual losses due to new market regulations, leaving the outlook was unsure.
Dealers had otherwise expected rises in the KFX index of up to a half percent point in the wake of Friday's higher Dow close on Wall Street.
Tele Danmark had fallen 15 crowns to 325 at 0750 gmt.
The KFX top-20 index had lost 0.49 point to 152.97 having closed 0.80 point higher on Friday.
